title: Customer-Managed HSM, Delegated RBAC & Audit Retention: Scope, PRD & Sign-off Checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD and sign-off checklist for enabling customer-managed HSM integrations for Private deployments with delegated RBAC mapping from customer identity providers (SAML/SCIM) and hardened audit retention. Goal: provide a clear, testable path for customers to bring their own HSM/KMS while preserving operator constraints, minimum evidence for compliance reviews (internal and customer), and automated test gating for rollouts.
scope_changes: 2026-02-24: Narrowed supported HSM protocols to PKCS#11 and KMIP only (was including proprietary vendor SDKs). Rationale: reduces maintenance & security review surface; customers with proprietary SDKs will run vendor side-proxy.

2026-02-27: Added delegated RBAC mapping requirement: customer groups must be mappable to Redwood operator roles via SAML claims or SCIM group sync (previously planned as manual mapping only). This increases SSO integration work by ~2 points.
2026-03-03: Increased minimum audit retention for Private deployments from 90 days to 365 days for regulated customers — added storage and indexing costs to cost estimate.
2026-03-08: Scope clarified that HSM quorum/escrow workflows will be documented but initial GA will not include multi-party escrow tooling; escrow integrations deferred to a follow-up epic.
requirements: SSO/SAML: Support SAML 2.0 with attribute mapping for 'roles' and 'groups'; fallback SCIM provisioning for group sync. Test harness: SAML IdP emulator with signed assertions.
RBAC: Implement delegated RBAC layer that maps customer identity groups to Redwood operator roles; support per-tenant role overrides and audit of mapping changes.

Audit logs: All operator actions related to key access, role grant/revoke, HSM provisioning, and key rotation must be logged in append-only format with integrity metadata (SHA256 chain) and exported to customer-specified SIEM endpoint and internal long-term archive.
KMS/HSM: Customer-managed KMS support via KMIP and PKCS#11. Provide validation checks for key attributes, algorithm compatibility (RSA/EC/AES), and key usability for signing and wrapping/unwrapping.
Key rotation & emergency access: Provide documented operator-run rotation procedures and emergency unseal path; automatic rotation can be scheduled but must be opt-in for customer-managed HSMs.
Encryption in transit & at rest: All control-plane traffic to HSM connectors must use mTLS; backups of key metadata (not private key material) must be encrypted with customer keys.
Identity proofing: Customers must present signed binding of tenancy to key material + legal attestation for on-boarding high-risk tenants; provide templates for legal evidence.
Operational telemetry: Metrics for HSM connectivity health, latency, last rotation, and per-tenant audit-event counts exposed to Console and Push to monitoring.
Compliance evidence: Deliverable evidence pack per customer including: binding certificates, audit log hashes, rotation logs, and RBAC mapping history for first onboarding window.

Failure modes & fallback: Define and implement graceful fallback to Redwood-managed encryption keys for non-blocking read-only workloads when customer HSM unreachable (requires explicit customer opt-in during onboarding).
acceptance_criteria: Security review sign-off checklist completed and uploaded to Confluence (security_review_required=true).
Integration acceptance tests green: SAML group mapping tests, KMIP/PKCS#11 connect/crypto smoke tests, and log export validation (3 IdPs and 2 HSM vendors in CI).
Operational runbook present and validated: rotation, emergency unseal, and loss-of-connectivity steps with playbook links and a post-mortem template.
Audit retention validated: search and retrieval test for events 12 months ago (indexed), and archive integrity verified (hash chain check).
RBAC mapping audit events are generated on every mapping change and are visible in Console with per-event actor, timestamp, and diff payload.
Legal evidence pack template reviewed by GTM and Legal and included in onboarding flow (Confluence link in 'links').
Cost impact doc reviewed and approved by Finance for increased retention and infrastructure overheads; acceptance of updated pricing/commit terms for Dedicated/Private customers.
Canary pilot with 2 customers completed without security incidents (pilot signoff notes attached).

decisions: Support KMIP and PKCS#11 only for GA (decision logged 2026-02-24).
Delegated RBAC will be implemented via SAML attribute mapping with SCIM group-sync as secondary path (decision 2026-02-27).
Minimum audit retention for regulated Private deployments set to 365 days (decision 2026-03-03).
Customer-managed HSM will default to 'no automatic rotation' until customer opts into managed rotation; emergency unseal documented but escrow tooling deferred (decision 2026-03-08).
